title: Vendor bills
description: Vendor bills are payable obligations. Matching links them to purchase orders and/or existing expenses - it never invents an expense.

bills.title: No vendor bills yet
bills.body: Record a vendor invoice, then propose matches to a PO and/or an existing expense. Accepting a match does not create an expense.

vendorsRequired.title: Add a vendor first
vendorsRequired.body: Vendor bills need a vendor. Create one, then come back to record the bill.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: You need vendor-bill permissions to view vendor bills.

detail.title: Vendor bill
detail.description: Propose and accept matches to POs and existing expenses. Accept never creates an expense.
detail.partialMatchHint: Partial matches are allowed. Status becomes partially matched until accepted amounts cover the bill total. Accepting a match never invents an expense.
detail.varianceWarning: Accepted matches exceed the bill by {variance} {currency}. Review variance before posting any separate expense.
detail.taxBasisLegacy: VAT was not split historically - cost = full amount
detail.taxBasisZero: Zero / exempt VAT - NET equals GROSS.
detail.taxBasisCanonical: VAT split - Actual uses NET, payable uses GROSS.
detail.actualHint: Actual / profit uses NET. Payable / aging uses GROSS. VAT is not profit.

match.hint: Select a purchase order and/or an existing expense. At least one target is required. Accepting will not create an expense. Multiple partial matches are allowed.

create.title: New vendor bill
create.description: Create a payable bill. This is not an expense - matching links to PO commitment and/or existing expense actuals.
create.dueDateHint: Leave empty to derive from the payment term when possible.
create.paymentTermHint: Defaults from the vendor when set. Does not rewrite an entered due date.
create.taxSplitHint: If checked, the entered amount is payable GROSS and VAT is split out. Actual cost uses NET. If unchecked, the entered amount is NET and VAT is added to payable using the organization tax rule.
create.saveAsDraftHint: A draft does not recognize Actual and does not consume PO commitment until posted.
create.actualVsPayableHint: Actual / profit = NET excluding VAT. Payable / aging = GROSS including VAT. VAT is not profit.

retention.title: Retention / holdback
retention.disclosure: Retention is cash timing, not a second cost. Recognized Actual stays the full bill amount; only payable now is reduced until release.
retention.percentHint: Optional. 10 means 10% of the bill total.
retention.captureHint: Set amount or percent on a draft. On post, held remaining equals retention. After post, increase only with a new bill.
retention.releaseHint: Partial release is allowed while held remaining is greater than zero. Releases are immutable history.
retention.noneHeld: No retention is held on this bill.

payments.title: Vendor payments
payments.cashOnlyNote: Payments are cash / AP only. They never increase Actual Cost - the vendor bill already recognized cost.
payments.schemaPending: Recording payments is not available in this environment yet. Outstanding below assumes no recorded payments yet.
payments.partialHint: Partial payments are allowed. Multiple payments can settle one bill.

credits.title: Vendor credits
credits.listDescription: Independent credit notes. Drafts stay off Actual until you post. Applying a credit reduces outstanding and Actual Cost - it is not a payment.
credits.notPaymentNote: Credits are not payments. Applying a credit reduces outstanding and Actual Cost.
credits.createHint: Creates a draft credit note. Review it, post it, then apply it to this bill. Drafts do not reduce Actual.
credits.success: Draft credit created. Open it to review, post, and apply.

emptyList.title: No vendor credits yet
emptyList.body: Create a credit note, review it, and post it. Drafts do not reduce Actual until posted. Applying to a bill is a separate step.

createPage.title: New vendor credit
createPage.description: Create a credit note. If approval is required it stays draft until you post after approval. It does not post silently and is not a payment.
createPage.taxSplitHint: If checked, the entered amount is payable GROSS and VAT is split out. Actual cost reduction uses NET. If unchecked, the entered amount is NET and VAT is added to the payable credit using the organization tax rule.
createPage.actualVsPayableHint: Payable reduction = GROSS. Actual / cost reduction = NET. VAT is not profit. Historical undivided credits keep tax = 0.

detail.title: Vendor credit
detail.description: Review, post, apply to a bill, or void. History is kept. Credits are not payments and must not double-count against the vendor bill.
detail.applicationsEmpty: Not applied to a bill yet. Remaining equals the credit amount.
detail.pendingApproval: Waiting for approval. This credit stays draft and does not reduce Actual until you post after approval.
detail.draftHint: Draft - not in Actual. Review the amount and date, then post. Posting is never silent.
detail.openHint: Open - recognized. Apply remaining to a payable bill to reduce outstanding and Actual.
detail.appliedHint: Fully applied. Outstanding and Actual already reflect this credit. Void to unwind.
detail.voidHint: Void. History is preserved. This credit no longer reduces Actual or outstanding.

edit.title: Edit draft
edit.note: Amount, date, notes, and reference can change only while this credit is draft.
edit.saved: Draft saved. It is still not posted.

post.title: Post credit
post.note: Posting moves draft to open. If approval is still pending, posting is blocked - it will not post silently.
post.success: Credit posted. It is open and can be applied to a bill.

apply.title: Apply to bill
apply.note: Applies remaining credit to a payable vendor bill. Reduces outstanding and Actual. Not a payment.
apply.success: Credit applied. Outstanding and Actual reduced.
apply.noBills: No payable bills for this vendor. Post a vendor bill first.

void.title: Void credit
void.note: Void preserves history. Active applications are unwound so outstanding and Actual are restored. The credit is not hard-deleted.
void.success: Credit voided. Applications were unwound. History remains.

post.title: Post draft bill
post.note: Draft bills do not recognize Actual Vendor Cost. Post after approval (when required) to open the bill.
post.success: Bill posted. It now recognizes Actual Vendor Cost.

void.title: Void bill
void.note: Void removes the bill from Actual recognition and supersedes allocations. History is preserved. Correction path is void + replace, or credit - never silent edit.
void.paymentsFirst: Void recorded payments on this bill before voiding the bill.
void.creditsFirst: Reverse applied vendor credits on this bill before voiding the bill.
void.success: Bill voided. It no longer contributes to Actual Cost.

aging.title: AP aging
aging.description: Payables aging by due date using outstanding (bill - payments - credits). Cash view - not Actual Cost.
aging.note: Buckets use outstanding only. Payments never increase Actual; credits reduce both outstanding and Actual.
aging.filterNote: Vendor/project query filters are reserved for a later pass; buckets show org-wide aging in the base currency.

allocation.title: Project cost allocation
allocation.subtitle: Send 100% to one project, or split by amount / % / days. Remainder stays visible as unallocated. Payment is separate.
allocation.gateOff: Project allocation cannot be saved in this environment yet. Preview only.
allocation.exceedsNet: Allocated total cannot exceed recognized bill NET.
allocation.draftSaved: Draft saved. Actual uses applied lines only - drafts do not claim Actual.
allocation.applied: Allocation applied. Project Actual uses these slices of bill NET.
allocation.paymentNote: PAYMENT ≠ Actual. Recording a payment does not allocate bill cost.

errors.targetRequired: Match requires a purchase order and/or an existing expense.
errors.expenseForbidden: Accepting a vendor-bill match must not create an expense.
errors.totalMismatch: Bill total must equal the sum of line totals.
errors.vendorMismatch: Purchase order vendor must match the bill vendor.
errors.poLineMismatch: Bill line PO line must belong to the selected purchase order.
errors.overMatch: Match amount would exceed the remaining unmatched bill total.
errors.matchNotProposed: Only proposed matches can be decided.
errors.linesRequired: Add at least one line with a description and amounts.
errors.paymentsSchemaPending: Vendor payments are not available in this environment yet.
errors.paymentApplicationRequired: Payment requires at least one bill application.
errors.paymentDuplicateBill: A payment cannot apply to the same bill twice.
errors.paymentBillNotPayable: Cannot pay a draft or void bill.
errors.paymentOverApplied: Payment would exceed the bill outstanding.
errors.paymentApplicationMismatch: Payment amount must equal the sum of applications.
errors.paymentNotVoidable: Only recorded payments can be voided.
errors.paymentVendorMismatch: All bill applications must share the same vendor.
errors.paymentAffectsActual: Vendor payment must never recognize Actual Cost.
errors.voidPaymentsFirst: Void recorded payments before voiding the vendor bill.
errors.voidCreditsFirst: Reverse applied vendor credits before voiding the vendor bill.
errors.billNotSilentlyEditable: Recognized bills cannot be silently edited; void and replace, or apply a credit.
errors.creditNotApplicable: Only open credits can be applied.
errors.creditBillNotPayable: Cannot apply credit to a draft or void bill.
errors.creditOverApplied: Credit application exceeds remaining credit or bill outstanding.
errors.creditsSchemaPending: Vendor credits are not available in this environment yet.
errors.creditNotDraft: Only draft vendor credits can be posted.
errors.creditNotDraftEditable: Only draft vendor credits can be edited.
errors.creditLockedPendingApproval: Amount and date are locked while approval is pending. Cancel the request or wait for a decision.
errors.creditNotSilentlyEditable: Posted vendor credits cannot be silently edited; void and replace, or apply remaining.
errors.billNotRecognized: Bill must be recognized before applying allocations.
errors.retentionExceedsTotal: Retention cannot exceed the bill total.
errors.retentionCannotIncrease: Retention cannot be increased after post; record a new bill.
errors.retentionNotReleasable: Retention can only be released after the bill is posted.
errors.retentionReleaseDateFuture: Release date cannot be in the future.
